column1: # The system properties Maven's JVM holds, measured on 2026-11-19 by
# output redirected) with maven-help-plugin 3.5.1: help:system for the names
# and values, and help:active-profiles over one <property> profile per name
# for the names a model sees. Then help:system on a terminal (script -qfc),
# on the Linux JDK 8 and 17. The JVMs:
# Columns, tab-separated: the name; the Maven lines whose run sets it; the
# JVMs that set it to a non-empty value, `all` for every one; `=value` when
# more than one sets it and all give that value, else `*`; notes: `late` for
# a name Maven sets after MavenCli copies the system properties, which no
# model sees; `empty:` for the JVMs that set it to the empty string; `tty`
# for a name only a run on a terminal has; `mavencli` for one MavenCli adds,
# which help:system does not list. The -D the runs passed is left out.
